description: Two-digit DANE code of the department. Key for department-level joins.
values: 33 codes, 05 to 99; Bogotá D.C. is 11; leading zero kept
derivation: Read as text; asserted to match ^[0-9]{2}$.

description: Canonical department name: the spelling used in the latest year in which the code appears.
values: 33 names; code 88 is Archipiélago de San Andrés, Providencia Y Santa Catalina
derivation: One name per dept_code, taken from the row with the highest year. Figures use shorter labels defined in index.qmd (dept_short).

description: Five-digit DANE code of the municipality; its first two digits equal dept_code. Together with year it identifies every municipal row exactly once. The token #TODOS marks a department aggregate row.
values: 1,095 municipality codes plus #TODOS; all codes exist in the DANE MGN 2020 register
derivation: Read as text; asserted to match ^[0-9]{5}$ or equal #TODOS, and to start with dept_code.

description: Canonical municipality name: the spelling used in the latest year in which the code appears. #TODOS on department rows. Names are not stable across years and 63 names are shared by municipalities in different departments, so they are labels, not keys.
derivation: One name per mpio_code, taken from the row with the highest year.

description: Calendar year of the annual IRCA.
derivation: Thousands separator removed (2,024 becomes 2024) and converted to integer; asserted to lie between 2000 and 2030.

description: Aggregation level of the row: municipality-year or department-year. Filter on it before any count or average, or departments are counted twice.
derivation: department when MunicipioCodigo equals #TODOS, municipality otherwise; asserted to agree with Municipio.

description: Annual Índice de Riesgo de la Calidad del Agua para Consumo Humano for the whole unit, a 0 to 100 score of deviation from Resolution 2115 of 2007.
derivation: Converted from text to numeric; the only non-numeric token allowed is ND; values asserted within 0 and 100.

description: Risk band of irca under Resolution 2115: no risk 0 to 5, low 5.1 to 14, medium 14.1 to 35, high 35.1 to 80, sanitarily unviable above 80.
values: No risk | Low risk | Medium risk | High risk | Sanitarily unviable
missing: never; always missing together with irca
derivation: The two raw spellings per band (Bajo riesgo and Riesgo bajo, Alto riesgo and Riesgo alto) are mapped to one English level by keyword; the reported band agrees with the band implied by the value in every row.
